warnings: *** THIS IS THE KEY FOR EVERY CIRCLED DIGIT IN THE BATHROOM SHEETS, and it is recorded once here rather than copied into A-11/A-12/A-13's plans. It is printed only on A-13 even though A-11 and A-12 use the same numbering - which is why those two sheets read as having no legend, and why both were flagged before this sheet was reached.

ITEM 3, โถปัสสาวะชาย, IS SCHEDULED BUT NEVER USED. No bathroom plan in this set tags a 3. The schedule is a series-wide standard list, so a scheduled row does not imply an installed fixture - this is the §7-checklist 'scheduled but not used' case, recorded rather than resolved away.

ITEM 9 CARRIES A UNIT ODDITY, RECORDED AS PRINTED: กระจกเงาอย่างดี หนา 1 1/2" หุน. It mixes an inch mark with หุน (a Thai eighth-of-an-inch unit), so the thickness reads as either 1.5 inches or 1.5 หุน (about 4.8 mm). A 4.8 mm mirror is the physically sensible one, but the sheet writes both units together, so no numeric thickness is recorded and the string is kept verbatim.

element_id here is the printed row number, per §0.2's rule that an entry with no printed mark takes the identifier the drawing does give it. The row numbers are the marks - they are what the plans reference.
